node.statement: Since P^2 = P and P*1 = 1, for every index i in I the fiber-aggregated masses c^{(i)}_Q := sum_{j in Q} P_{ij}, taken over all row-point fibers Q, satisfy sum_Q c^{(i)}_Q = 1 and p_i = sum_Q c^{(i)}_Q * p_Q.
